name: CellBinDB
description: A large-scale multimodal annotated dataset for cell segmentation with benchmark evaluations of universal segmentation models across modalities.
reputation: A large, modality-diverse bioimage segmentation benchmark gaining attention in the bioimage-analysis community for cross-modality evaluation.
notes: Domain-specific microscopy modalities and staining variations make generalization challenging; annotation quality and inter-modality consistency can vary; not an LLM benchmark.
